facts.fact: David 谎称从 Jim 家偷来带子；Erin 不敢相信
David 承认回去 Troy 几次、从 Jim 没锁的后门潜入偷带
facts.anchor: I went back to Troy a few times after we took that trip. I scoped out that weirdo’s house from afar. He leaves his back door unlocked.

facts.fact: David 告知片尾有 Erin 的 Script Girl credit
facts.anchor: The credits. You’re in them, Erin. You’re listed as the Script Girl.

facts.fact: Erin 撕碎 VHS、把残骸扔进床边垃圾桶
facts.anchor: She ripped the VHS apart, forcing the film out from its binding. Then once she’d mangled it sufficiently, she dumped the ruined tape’s remains in the trash can by her bed.

facts.fact: 周一车上父亲 Lawrence 告诫两人将走上不同人生路、嘲讽 Blockbuster
facts.anchor: you and David are going to be on very different life paths. You’ve got so much to look forward to in your future. And he…well, I hope he gets that job at Blockbuster he’s always wanted.

facts.fact: 学校走廊 Erin 说自己毁了带子、受够了整件事
facts.anchor: “I destroyed it. I just—David, this whole thing is too creepy.

facts.fact: 母亲 Mary 转述父亲用工具箱把带子修好、放回床上
facts.anchor: He said he got out his toolbox and fixed it up for you.

facts.fact: 深夜 Erin 独自看完 22 分钟 Air Ball Blues 却什么都没发生
facts.anchor: She sat on the carpet in front of the screen and watched all twenty-two minutes of “Air Ball Blues,” that very special episode that was supposed to change her life.
